ext_name.message: Kavach: Indian PII shield for AI chats

ext_description.message: Warns before you send Aadhaar, PAN, UPI, bank or phone details to ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and masks them. Runs on your device.

banner_body.message: Mask replaces them with placeholders like [PAN_1] before anything leaves your browser.

notice_masked.message: Masked. Check the message, then send it.

masked_note.message: (Kavach: values in [brackets] are hidden personal details. Keep them as they are.)

popup_tagline.message: Indian PII shield for AI chats

popup_privacy.message: Runs entirely on your device. Kavach never sends your messages anywhere, and stores only these counts.

popup_limits.message: Kavach reduces risk; it can miss things. Check before you send.
